title: Intake Limits, Declared Value Ceilings and Custody Cover by Service Level
content:
# Care, Custody and Control Bulletin: Intake Limits, Declared Value Ceilings and Custody Cover

Every piece the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service takes in is taken in at a service level, and the level fixes the highest value a piece may be taken in at, the value above which the customer must sign the stone release, the most the chain answers for while the piece is in its care, and the certification the bench jeweler working at that level must hold.

| Level figure | Standard Bench Service | Priority Bench Service | Master Jeweler Service | Heritage Restoration Service | Designer Authorized Repair Service | Atelier White-Glove Service |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Highest declared value a piece may be taken in at, USD | 7500.00 | 15000.00 | 40000.00 | 100000.00 | 150000.00 | 500000.00 |
| Declared value above which the stone release must be signed, USD | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 7500.00 | 10000.00 |
| Most the chain answers for while the piece is in its care, USD | 7500.00 | 15000.00 | 40000.00 | 100000.00 | 150000.00 | 500000.00 |
| Antique and estate restoration admitted | no | no | yes | yes | no | yes |
| Designer's written authorisation required before the piece is worked on | no | no | no | no | yes | yes |
| Work orders one customer may have running at this level at once | 4 | 4 | 3 | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| Piece photographed at intake and at completion | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Certification the bench jeweler must hold | bench certified | bench certified | master bench certified | restoration certified | designer authorized | atelier master |

## Notes on the limits

1. The declared value ceiling and the care, custody and control cover cap carry the same figure at each level, running from 7500.00 USD at Standard Bench Service to 500000.00 USD at Atelier White-Glove Service.
2. The stone release threshold is a declared value *above* which the signed release is required: at Master Jeweler Service a piece carried at exactly 5000.00 USD is not above the threshold, and one carried at 5000.01 USD is.
3. Antique and estate restoration is admitted at Master Jeweler Service, Heritage Restoration Service and Atelier White-Glove Service. The designer's written authorisation must already be on file at Designer Authorized Repair Service and Atelier White-Glove Service.
4. The cap on running work orders tightens as the levels rise, from 4 at Standard Bench Service and Priority Bench Service to 1 at Atelier White-Glove Service.
5. Photographs at intake and at completion are required at every level except Standard Bench Service.
